defs: n	An unsought, unintended or unexpected, but fortunate, discovery or learning experience that occurs by accident.
n	The phenomenon of making an unplanned, fortunate discovery through a combination of unexpected circumstances and insightful recognition.
n	The occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.
n	(mineralogy) A triclinic-pinacoidal mineral containing aluminum, boron, calcium, magnesium, oxygen, and silicon.
